skill.summary: Expert AI agent specializing in game audio engineer. From The Agency (github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents).

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agency-game-audio-engineer.

- Provides expertise in designing and implementing interactive game audio systems, including SFX, music, voice, and spatial audio.
- Supports integration with FMOD, Wwise, and native engine audio across Unity, Unreal, and Godot.
- Focuses on systems design, scalability, adaptive music transitions, and audio performance optimization.
- Offers guidance on audio budgets, mixer architecture, and bridging audio design with engine integration.
- Can recall and apply memory of past audio implementation issues for improved future solutions.
